headline: Discussion Map, from entry to detail
overview: Discussion Map is a meeting analysis tool that helps you understand the dynamics of group conversations. After logging a meeting, you can map who spoke to whom, track influence patterns, and visualize who drives decisions in your team. The resulting influence graph reveals participation imbalances, dominant voices, and collaboration gaps that are hard to notice in real time.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Discussion Map — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with options to start a new meeting analysis or review past sessions.
steps.screenshotAlt: Discussion Map landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Visual influence graph showing who drives decisions in meetings
Track speaking patterns and participation across all meeting participants
Identify collaboration gaps and dominant voices in group discussions
Meeting history with comparative analysis across sessions
tips: Map discussions immediately after a meeting while the conversation dynamics are fresh
Look for participants who are rarely connected to others — they may have valuable ideas that aren't being heard
